local function createFire(parent)
    local emitter = Instance.new('ParticleEmitter')
    emitter.Texture = 'rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds'
    emitter.LightEmission = 1
    emitter.LightInfluence = 0
    emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 150)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(60, 10, 0)),
    })
    emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.5),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 2.5),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
    })
    emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.3),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
    emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 6)
    emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
    emitter.Rate = 40
    emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
    emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-60, 60)
    emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(15, 15)
    emitter.Parent = parent
    return emitter
end

instruction: Write a Luau script for a smooth camera shake with falloff that cleans up after itself.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
    local name = 'CameraShake_' .. tostring(os.clock())
    local startTime = os.clock()
    RunService:BindToRenderStep(name, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
        local alpha = (os.clock() - startTime) / duration
        if alpha >= 1 then
            RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(name)
            return
        end
        local falloff = (1 - alpha) ^ 2
        local rx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * intensity * falloff
        local ry = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * intensity * falloff
        camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rx), math.rad(ry), 0)
    end)
end

    local ring = Instance.new('Part')
    ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    ring.Anchored = true
    ring.CanCollide = false
    ring.CanQuery = false
    ring.CanTouch = false

    ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 1, 1)

    ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
    ring.Parent = workspace

    local info = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(ring, info, {
        Size = Vector3.new(0.3, maxRadius * 2, maxRadius * 2),
        Transparency = 1,
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(ring, 0.6)
end

instruction: How do I implement a proper hitstop (freeze frame) in Roblox combat using animation speed?
output:
local function hitstop(character, duration)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
    if not animator then return end

    local tracks = animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
    for _, track in tracks do
        track:AdjustSpeed(0)
    end

    task.delay(duration, function()
        for _, track in tracks do
            if track.IsPlaying then
                track:AdjustSpeed(1)
            end
        end
    end)
end

instruction: Write a Luau function that draws a jagged lightning bolt between two points.
output:
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local function lightning(startPos, endPos, segments, jitter, color)
    local folder = Instance.new('Folder')
    folder.Name = 'LightningBolt'
    folder.Parent = workspace

    local points = {}
    local dir = endPos - startPos
    for i = 0, segments do
        local p = startPos + dir * (i / segments)
        if i > 0 and i < segments then
            p += Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * jitter
        end
        points[i + 1] = p
    end

    for i = 1, #points - 1 do
        local a, b = points[i], points[i + 1]
        local len = (b - a).Magnitude
        local seg = Instance.new('Part')
        seg.Anchored = true
        seg.CanCollide = false
        seg.CanQuery = false
        seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        seg.Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)
        seg.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, len)
        seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(a, b) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -len / 2)
        seg.Parent = folder
    end
    Debris:AddItem(folder, 0.15)
end

local function afterimage(character, lifetime, color)
    for _, part in character:GetDescendants() do
        if part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Name ~= 'HumanoidRootPart' and part.Transparency < 1 then
            local ghost = part:Clone()
            if ghost then
                ghost:ClearAllChildren()
                ghost.Anchored = true
                ghost.CanCollide = false
                ghost.CanQuery = false
                ghost.CanTouch = false
                ghost.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                ghost.Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
                ghost.Transparency = 0.4
                ghost.CFrame = part.CFrame
                ghost.Parent = workspace
                TweenService:Create(ghost, TweenInfo.new(lifetime), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
                Debris:AddItem(ghost, lifetime)
            end
        end
    end
end

    TweenService:Create(blur, inInfo, {Size = 12}):Play()

        TweenService:Create(cc, outInfo, {Saturation = 0, Contrast = 0, TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(blur, outInfo, {Size = 0}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(bloom, outInfo, {Intensity = 0}):Play()

local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local function tornado(position, height, duration)
    local folder = Instance.new('Folder')
    folder.Name = 'Tornado'
    folder.Parent = workspace

    local pieces = {}
    local count = 24
    for i = 1, count do
        local p = Instance.new('Part')
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255)
        p.Transparency = 0.4
        p.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 0.2, 1.2)
        p.Parent = folder
        pieces[i] = {part = p, h = i / count}
    end

    local t0 = os.clock()
    local conn
    conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local t = os.clock() - t0
        if t > duration then
            conn:Disconnect()
            folder:Destroy()
            return
        end
        for _, data in pieces do
            local radius = 2 + data.h * 8
            local angle = t * 6 + data.h * math.pi * 6
            local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, data.h * height, math.sin(angle) * radius)
            data.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + offset) * CFrame.Angles(0, -angle, 0)
        end
    end)
end

instruction: Write a reusable VFX object pool module in Luau to avoid constant Instance creation.
output:
local VFXPool = {}
VFXPool.__index = VFXPool

function VFXPool.new(template, size)
    local self = setmetatable({}, VFXPool)
    self._template = template
    self._free = {}
    for _ = 1, size do
        table.insert(self._free, template:Clone())
    end
    return self
end

function VFXPool:Get()
    return table.remove(self._free) or self._template:Clone()
end

function VFXPool:Release(obj)
    obj.Parent = nil
    table.insert(self._free, obj)
end

function VFXPool:Play(parent, cframe, lifetime)
    local obj = self:Get()
    obj.CFrame = cframe
    obj.Parent = parent
    task.delay(lifetime, function()
        self:Release(obj)
    end)
    return obj
end

return VFXPool

local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('VFXEvent')

    for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
        local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if root and (root.Position - position).Magnitude <= radius then
            remote:FireClient(player, effectName, position, data)
        end
    end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('VFXEvent')

    Shockwave = function(position, data) end,
    Explosion = function(position, data) end,
}

    local handler = effects[effectName]
    if handler then
        handler(position, data)
    end
end)

local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local function fireball(origin, direction, speed, maxDistance, ignoreList)
    local ball = Instance.new('Part')
    ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    ball.Size = Vector3.one * 2
    ball.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    ball.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 20)
    ball.Anchored = true
    ball.CanCollide = false
    ball.CanQuery = false
    ball.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin)
    ball.Parent = workspace

    local fire = Instance.new('ParticleEmitter')
    fire.Texture = 'rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds'
    fire.LightEmission = 1
    fire.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 2.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
    fire.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.6)
    fire.Rate = 60
    fire.Parent = ball

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList or {}

    local traveled = 0
    local conn
    local function finish(pos)
        conn:Disconnect()
        fire.Enabled = false
        ball.Transparency = 1
        local burst = Instance.new('ParticleEmitter')
        burst.Texture = 'rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds'
        burst.LightEmission = 1
        burst.Speed = NumberRange.new(20, 40)
        burst.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
        burst.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
        burst.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8)
        burst.Enabled = false
        burst.Parent = ball
        if pos then ball.Position = pos end
        burst:Emit(30)
        Debris:AddItem(ball, 1)
    end

instruction: What is the difference between Beam, Trail and ParticleEmitter in Roblox VFX, and when should I use each?
output: Use ParticleEmitter for volumetric, randomized effects (fire, smoke, sparks, magic bursts) because it spawns many short-lived sprites. Use Beam for a stretched textured ribbon between two Attachments, which suits lasers, lightning, energy links and slash lines. Use Trail for a ribbon that follows a moving object between two attachments and leaves a fading path, which suits sword swings, projectiles and dash streaks. Beam is static between fixed endpoints, Trail is generated by motion, and ParticleEmitter is generated by emission rules.

instruction: When should I use ParticleEmitter:Emit() instead of Rate in Roblox?
output: Use Rate for continuous effects such as auras, fire and smoke that run while something is active. Use :Emit(count) for one-shot bursts such as impacts, hits and explosions, where you want an exact number of particles at an exact moment, usually synced to an animation marker. For bursts, set Enabled = false so only the Emit call produces particles, and remember to Debris the emitter or its parent afterward.

instruction: List the main principles that make anime-style combat VFX in Roblox feel good.
output:
1. Anticipation: add a short charge-up (inward particles, glow, pose) before the hit.
2. Impact frames: use hitstop (30 to 80 ms), a quick screen flash and a small camera shake on contact.
3. Strong silhouettes: use bright neon colors with high LightEmission and a clear shape such as a ring, slash arc or pillar.
4. Fast in, slow out: tween with Exponential or Quad Out easing so effects pop quickly then fade slowly.
5. Layering: combine 3 to 5 elements (shockwave, sparks, smoke, light pulse, debris) rather than one big effect.
6. Color discipline: pick a primary and an accent color per move and keep them consistent.
7. Short lifetimes: most hit effects should finish in under 1 second so combat stays readable.
8. Sound sync: align SFX to the exact impact frame.

instruction: What are the best practices for optimizing VFX performance in Roblox?
output: Keep particle Rate and Lifetime low and prefer fewer, larger sprites over many small ones. Use :Emit() bursts instead of long-running emitters. Pool and reuse effect instances for frequently used VFX. Always clean up with Debris:AddItem or explicit Destroy, and disconnect every Heartbeat/RenderStepped connection when the effect ends. Spawn visual-only parts as Anchored with CanCollide, CanQuery and CanTouch set to false. Run purely cosmetic effects on the client and only replicate the trigger from the server, ideally only to nearby players. Scale effect density by device and graphics quality. Avoid Shadows on PointLights and avoid many overlapping transparent parts.

instruction: Why should VFX run on the client instead of the server in Roblox?
output: Cosmetic effects do not need to be authoritative, so running them on the client avoids network and server CPU cost, removes latency, and lets each player scale quality for their own device. The server should handle gameplay logic (damage, hit detection, cooldowns) and send a small RemoteEvent message such as the effect name, position and a few parameters. Each client then plays the effect locally. Parts created on the server replicate to everyone and can cause lag and visual stutter, so avoid spawning large numbers of effect parts there.

instruction: Find the bug in this VFX script and give a fixed version.
input:
local function shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
    local startTime = tick()
    game:GetService('RunService').RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if tick() - startTime > duration then return end
        local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-intensity, intensity)/10, math.random(-intensity, intensity)/10, 0)
        workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
    end)
end
output:
The bug: RenderStepped:Connect is never disconnected, so every call leaves a permanent connection that keeps shaking the camera and leaks memory. Also math.random(-intensity, intensity) only returns integers.

Fixed version:

local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
    local startTime = os.clock()
    local conn
    conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local alpha = (os.clock() - startTime) / duration
        if alpha >= 1 then
            conn:Disconnect()
            return
        end
        local falloff = 1 - alpha
        local offset = Vector3.new(
            (math.random() - 0.5) * intensity * falloff,
            (math.random() - 0.5) * intensity * falloff,
            0
        )
        camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
    end)
end

instruction: Implement a production-grade Signal class in Luau with Connect, Once, Wait, Fire and DisconnectAll that is safe to disconnect during Fire.
output:
--!nonstrict
local Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection

function Connection:Disconnect()
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local list = self._signal._connections
    local index = table.find(list, self)
    if index then
        table.remove(list, index)
    end
end

local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal

function Signal.new()
    return setmetatable({_connections = {}}, Signal)
end

function Signal:Connect(fn)
    local connection = setmetatable({Connected = true, _fn = fn, _signal = self}, Connection)
    table.insert(self._connections, connection)
    return connection
end

function Signal:Once(fn)
    local connection
    connection = self:Connect(function(...)
        connection:Disconnect()
        fn(...)
    end)
    return connection
end

function Signal:Fire(...)
    -- snapshot so handlers can connect/disconnect while firing
    local snapshot = table.clone(self._connections)
    for _, connection in snapshot do
        if connection.Connected then
            task.spawn(connection._fn, ...)
        end
    end
end

function Signal:Wait()
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    self:Once(function(...)
        task.spawn(thread, ...)
    end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function Signal:DisconnectAll()
    for _, connection in self._connections do
        connection.Connected = false
    end
    table.clear(self._connections)
end

return Signal

instruction: Write a Janitor (Maid) class in Luau that cleans up connections, instances, threads, functions and objects in reverse order and can link to an Instance's lifetime.
output:
--!nonstrict
local Janitor = {}
Janitor.__index = Janitor

function Janitor.new()
    return setmetatable({_tasks = {}}, Janitor)
end

function Janitor:Add(item, methodName)
    table.insert(self._tasks, {item = item, method = methodName})
    return item
end

local function clean(entry)
    local item, method = entry.item, entry.method
    if method then
        item[method](item)
        return
    end
    local kind = typeof(item)
    if kind == 'function' then
        item()
    elseif kind == 'RBXScriptConnection' then
        item:Disconnect()
    elseif kind == 'Instance' then
        item:Destroy()
    elseif kind == 'thread' then
        pcall(task.cancel, item)
    elseif kind == 'table' then
        if item.Destroy then
            item:Destroy()
        elseif item.Disconnect then
            item:Disconnect()
        end
    end
end

function Janitor:Cleanup()
    local tasks = self._tasks
    self._tasks = {}
    for i = #tasks, 1, -1 do
        local ok, err = pcall(clean, tasks[i])
        if not ok then
            warn('[Janitor] cleanup error: ' .. tostring(err))
        end
    end
end
Janitor.Destroy = Janitor.Cleanup

function Janitor:LinkToInstance(instance)
    self:Add(instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
        self:Cleanup()
    end))
    return self
end

return Janitor

instruction: Implement a general-purpose analytic damped spring in Luau that works for numbers, Vector2 and Vector3 and supports impulses, for use in cameras, UI and VFX.
output:
--!nonstrict
local Spring = {}
Spring.__index = Spring

function Spring.new(initial, frequency, damping)
    return setmetatable({
        Position = initial,
        Velocity = initial * 0,
        Target = initial,
        Frequency = frequency or 4,   -- Hz
        Damping = damping or 1,       -- 1 = critically damped, <1 bouncy, >1 sluggish
    }, Spring)
end

function Spring:Impulse(velocity)
    self.Velocity += velocity
end

function Spring:Update(dt)
    local f = self.Frequency * 2 * math.pi
    local d = self.Damping
    local goal = self.Target
    local offset = self.Position - goal
    local vel = self.Velocity

    if d == 1 then
        local decay = math.exp(-f * dt)
        self.Position = (offset * (1 + f * dt) + vel * dt) * decay + goal
        self.Velocity = (vel * (1 - f * dt) - offset * (f * f * dt)) * decay
    elseif d < 1 then
        local decay = math.exp(-d * f * dt)
        local c = math.sqrt(1 - d * d)
        local i = math.cos(f * c * dt)
        local j = math.sin(f * c * dt)
        local y = j / (f * c)
        local z = j / c
        self.Position = (offset * (i + z * d) + vel * y) * decay + goal
        self.Velocity = (vel * (i - z * d) - offset * (z * f)) * decay
    else
        local c = math.sqrt(d * d - 1)
        local r1 = -f * (d + c)
        local r2 = -f * (d - c)
        local co2 = (vel - offset * r1) / (2 * f * c)
        local co1 = offset - co2
        local e1 = co1 * math.exp(r1 * dt)
        local e2 = co2 * math.exp(r2 * dt)
        self.Position = e1 + e2 + goal
        self.Velocity = e1 * r1 + e2 * r2
    end
    return self.Position
end

return Spring

instruction: Build a minimal ECS (entity component system) in Luau for managing thousands of projectiles, with queries and deferred despawn.
output:
--!nonstrict
local World = {}
World.__index = World

function World.new()
    return setmetatable({
        _nextId = 0,
        _components = {},
        _dead = {},
        _systems = {},
    }, World)
end

function World:Spawn(components)
    self._nextId += 1
    local id = self._nextId
    for name, data in components do
        local store = self._components[name]
        if not store then
            store = {}
            self._components[name] = store
        end
        store[id] = data
    end
    return id
end

function World:Despawn(id)
    table.insert(self._dead, id)  -- deferred: safe to call mid-iteration
end

function World:Get(name, id)
    local store = self._components[name]
    return store and store[id]
end

function World:Query(...)
    local names = {...}
    local results = {}
    local first = self._components[names[1]]
    if not first then return results end
    for id in first do
        local matches = true
        for i = 2, #names do
            local store = self._components[names[i]]
            if not store or store[id] == nil then
                matches = false
                break
            end
        end
        if matches then
            results[#results + 1] = id
        end
    end
    return results
end

function World:AddSystem(system)
    table.insert(self._systems, system)
end

function World:Step(dt)
    for _, system in self._systems do
        system(self, dt)
    end
    for _, id in self._dead do
        for _, store in self._components do
            store[id] = nil
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._dead)
end

-- Example systems -----------------------------------------------------
local function movementSystem(world, dt)
    for _, id in world:Query('Position', 'Velocity') do
        local pos, vel = world:Get('Position', id), world:Get('Velocity', id)
        pos.Value += vel.Value * dt
    end
end

local function lifetimeSystem(world, dt)
    for _, id in world:Query('Lifetime') do
        local life = world:Get('Lifetime', id)
        life.Remaining -= dt
        if life.Remaining <= 0 then
            local view = world:Get('View', id)
            if view then view.Part:Destroy() end
            world:Despawn(id)
        end
    end
end

local function renderSystem(world)
    for _, id in world:Query('Position', 'View') do
        world:Get('View', id).Part.Position = world:Get('Position', id).Value
    end
end

return {World = World, Systems = {movementSystem, lifetimeSystem, renderSystem}}

instruction: Write a generic finite state machine (FSM) class in Luau with Enter/Update/Exit hooks, event transitions with guards, and timed transitions, then use it for a combat character.
output:
--!nonstrict
local FSM = {}
FSM.__index = FSM

function FSM.new(definition, initialState, context)
    local self = setmetatable({
        Current = nil,
        _def = definition,
        _ctx = context,
        _time = 0,
        _listeners = {},
    }, FSM)
    self:_enter(initialState)
    return self
end

function FSM:OnChanged(fn)
    table.insert(self._listeners, fn)
end

function FSM:_enter(name, ...)
    local state = assert(self._def[name], 'Unknown state: ' .. tostring(name))
    self.Current = name
    self._time = 0
    if state.Enter then
        state.Enter(self._ctx, ...)
    end
end

function FSM:Transition(name, ...)
    local old = self.Current
    local oldState = old and self._def[old]
    if oldState and oldState.Exit then
        oldState.Exit(self._ctx, name)
    end
    self:_enter(name, ...)
    for _, fn in self._listeners do
        task.spawn(fn, old, name)
    end
end

function FSM:Fire(event, ...)
    local state = self._def[self.Current]
    local rule = state.On and state.On[event]
    if not rule then return false end
    local target = rule
    if type(rule) == 'function' then
        target = rule(self._ctx, ...)  -- guard: return nil to refuse
    end
    if target then
        self:Transition(target, ...)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function FSM:Update(dt)
    self._time += dt
    local state = self._def[self.Current]
    if state.Update then
        state.Update(self._ctx, dt, self._time)
    end
    local after = state.After
    if after and self._time >= after.Time then
        self:Transition(after.To)
    end
end

-- Usage ----------------------------------------------------------------
local ctx = {Stamina = 100}
local combat = FSM.new({
    Idle = {
        On = {
            Attack = function(c) return c.Stamina >= 10 and 'Windup' or nil end,
            Hit = 'Stunned',
        },
    },
    Windup = {After = {Time = 0.15, To = 'Attack'}, On = {Hit = 'Stunned'}},
    Attack = {
        Enter = function(c) c.Stamina -= 10 end,
        After = {Time = 0.2, To = 'Recovery'},
    },
    Recovery = {After = {Time = 0.25, To = 'Idle'}},
    Stunned = {After = {Time = 0.6, To = 'Idle'}},
}, 'Idle', ctx)

game:GetService('RunService').Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    combat:Update(dt)
end)

local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local Janitor = require(script.Parent.Janitor)

local function bindComponent(tag, class)
    local active = {}

    local function add(instance)
        if active[instance] then return end
        active[instance] = class.new(instance)
    end

    local function remove(instance)
        local component = active[instance]
        if component then
            active[instance] = nil
            component:Destroy()
        end
    end

    CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tag):Connect(add)
    CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(tag):Connect(remove)
    for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged(tag) do
        task.spawn(add, instance)
    end
    return active
end

local LaserTrap = {}
LaserTrap.__index = LaserTrap

function LaserTrap.new(part)
    local self = setmetatable({_janitor = Janitor.new(), _part = part}, LaserTrap)
    local damage = part:GetAttribute('Damage') or 10
    local lastTick = 0
    self._janitor:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

        lastTick = os.clock()
        local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
        for _, hit in workspace:GetPartsInPart(part, overlap) do
            local humanoid = hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if humanoid then
                humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            end
        end
    end))
    self._janitor:LinkToInstance(part)
    return self
end

function LaserTrap:Destroy()
    self._janitor:Cleanup()
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')

local RateLimiter = {}
RateLimiter.__index = RateLimiter

function RateLimiter.new(capacity, refillPerSecond)
    local self = setmetatable({
        _capacity = capacity,
        _rate = refillPerSecond,
        _buckets = {},
    }, RateLimiter)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        self._buckets[player] = nil
    end)
    return self
end

function RateLimiter:Allow(player, cost)
    cost = cost or 1
    local now = os.clock()
    local bucket = self._buckets[player]
    if not bucket then
        bucket = {tokens = self._capacity, t = now}
        self._buckets[player] = bucket
    end
    bucket.tokens = math.min(self._capacity, bucket.tokens + (now - bucket.t) * self._rate)
    bucket.t = now
    if bucket.tokens >= cost then
        bucket.tokens -= cost
        return true
    end
    return false
end

return RateLimiter
-- Usage: local limiter = RateLimiter.new(5, 2) -- burst of 5, then 2/sec
-- if not limiter:Allow(player) then return end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local RateLimiter = require(script.Parent.RateLimiter)

local AbilityRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('AbilityRemote')
local VFXRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('VFXRemote')

local DAMAGE = 25
local RANGE = 14
local COOLDOWN = 0.6
local limiter = RateLimiter.new(6, 3)
local lastUse = {}

local function getRootAndHumanoid(model)
    local root = model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    if root and root:IsA('BasePart') and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
        return root, humanoid
    end
end

AbilityRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, targetModel)
    if not limiter:Allow(player) then return end
    if typeof(targetModel) ~= 'Instance' or not targetModel:IsA('Model') then return end

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (lastUse[player] or 0) < COOLDOWN then return end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character or targetModel == character then return end
    local root = getRootAndHumanoid(character)
    local targetRoot, targetHumanoid = getRootAndHumanoid(targetModel)
    if not root or not targetRoot then return end

    local offset = targetRoot.Position - root.Position
    if offset.Magnitude > RANGE then return end

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    local result = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, offset, params)
    if result and not result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetModel) then
        return  -- blocked by a wall
    end

    lastUse[player] = now
    targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)  -- damage is decided by the server only
    VFXRemote:FireAllClients('Hit', targetRoot.Position)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    lastUse[player] = nil
end)

instruction: Implement server-side lag compensation in Luau: record position history per player and validate a client's claimed hit by rewinding to the client's timestamp with a capped rewind window.
output:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local HISTORY_SECONDS = 1
local MAX_REWIND = 0.25
local history = {}  -- [Player] = { {t = number, cf = CFrame}, ... }

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if root then
            local list = history[player]
            if not list then
                list = {}
                history[player] = list
            end
            table.insert(list, {t = now, cf = root.CFrame})
            while #list > 0 and now - list[1].t > HISTORY_SECONDS do
                table.remove(list, 1)
            end
        end
    end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    history[player] = nil
end)

local function getRewound(player, t)
    local list = history[player]
    if not list or #list < 2 then return nil end
    t = math.clamp(t, list[1].t, list[#list].t)
    for i = #list - 1, 1, -1 do
        local a, b = list[i], list[i + 1]
        if t >= a.t then
            local alpha = (t - a.t) / math.max(b.t - a.t, 1e-4)
            return a.cf:Lerp(b.cf, alpha)
        end
    end
    return list[1].cf
end

-- clientTime must come from workspace:GetServerTimeNow() on the client when the attack was fired
local function validateHit(attacker, target, clientTime, maxRange)
    if typeof(clientTime) ~= 'number' then return false end
    local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    local t = math.clamp(clientTime, now - MAX_REWIND, now)  -- never rewind further than the cap
    local attackerCF = getRewound(attacker, t)
    local targetCF = getRewound(target, t)
    if not attackerCF or not targetCF then return false end
    local tolerance = 2
    return (attackerCF.Position - targetCF.Position).Magnitude <= maxRange + tolerance
end

return validateHit

-- SERVER ---------------------------------------------------------------
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local DashRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('DashRemote')
local DASH_DISTANCE = 30
local COOLDOWN = 1.2
local lastDash = {}

DashRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, seq, direction)
    if typeof(seq) ~= 'number' or typeof(direction) ~= 'Vector3' then return end
    if direction ~= direction then return end  -- NaN check
    if os.clock() - (lastDash[player] or 0) < COOLDOWN then return end

    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not root then return end

    local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
    flat = flat.Unit

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, flat * DASH_DISTANCE, params)
    local distance = hit and math.max(hit.Distance - 2, 0) or DASH_DISTANCE

    lastDash[player] = os.clock()
    local newPos = root.Position + flat * distance
    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos) * root.CFrame.Rotation
    DashRemote:FireClient(player, seq, newPos)  -- acknowledge with the authoritative result
end)

-- CLIENT ---------------------------------------------------------------
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local DashRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('DashRemote')
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local pending = {}
local sequence = 0
local DASH_DISTANCE = 30

local function dash(direction)
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not root then return end
    local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
    flat = flat.Unit

    sequence += 1
    local predicted = root.Position + flat * DASH_DISTANCE
    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(predicted) * root.CFrame.Rotation  -- instant local feedback
    pending[sequence] = predicted
    DashRemote:FireServer(sequence, flat)
end

DashRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(ackSeq, serverPos)
    local predicted = pending[ackSeq]
    pending[ackSeq] = nil
    local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if root and predicted and (predicted - serverPos).Magnitude > 3 then
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(serverPos) * root.CFrame.Rotation  -- reconcile
    end
end)

instruction: Write a snapshot interpolation system in Luau that smooths remote entities using a render delay buffer and short extrapolation.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local RENDER_DELAY = 0.1
local MAX_EXTRAPOLATION = 0.1
local snapshots = {}

local function pushSnapshot(serverTime, cframe)
    table.insert(snapshots, {t = serverTime, cf = cframe})
    while #snapshots > 30 do
        table.remove(snapshots, 1)
    end
end

local function sample(renderTime)
    local n = #snapshots
    if n == 0 then return nil end
    if n == 1 or renderTime <= snapshots[1].t then
        return snapshots[1].cf
    end
    for i = n - 1, 1, -1 do
        local a, b = snapshots[i], snapshots[i + 1]
        if renderTime >= a.t then
            if renderTime > b.t then
                local over = math.min(renderTime - b.t, MAX_EXTRAPOLATION)
                local velocity = (b.cf.Position - a.cf.Position) / math.max(b.t - a.t, 1e-3)
                return b.cf + velocity * over
            end
            return a.cf:Lerp(b.cf, (renderTime - a.t) / (b.t - a.t))
        end
    end
    return snapshots[1].cf
end

local function bind(remotePart)
    return RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local cf = sample(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - RENDER_DELAY)
        if cf then
            remotePart.CFrame = cf
        end
    end)
end

return {Push = pushSnapshot, Bind = bind}

instruction: Serialize VFX replication packets into a compact buffer in Luau (effect id, position, color, random seed) and decode them on the client.
output:
--!strict
local PACKET_SIZE = 20

local function packVFX(effectId: number, position: Vector3, color: Color3, seed: number): buffer
    local b = buffer.create(PACKET_SIZE)
    buffer.writeu8(b, 0, effectId)
    buffer.writef32(b, 1, position.X)
    buffer.writef32(b, 5, position.Y)
    buffer.writef32(b, 9, position.Z)
    buffer.writeu8(b, 13, math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5))
    buffer.writeu8(b, 14, math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5))
    buffer.writeu8(b, 15, math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5))
    buffer.writeu32(b, 16, seed)
    return b
end

local function unpackVFX(b: buffer): (number, Vector3, Color3, number)
    local effectId = buffer.readu8(b, 0)
    local position = Vector3.new(buffer.readf32(b, 1), buffer.readf32(b, 5), buffer.readf32(b, 9))
    local color = Color3.fromRGB(buffer.readu8(b, 13), buffer.readu8(b, 14), buffer.readu8(b, 15))
    local seed = buffer.readu32(b, 16)
    return effectId, position, color, seed
end

-- Server: remote:FireAllClients(packVFX(3, pos, Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255), math.random(1, 2^31)))
-- Client: remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(b) local id, pos, color, seed = unpackVFX(b) end)
return {Pack = packVFX, Unpack = unpackVFX}

instruction: Implement a deterministic fractal lightning generator in Luau that uses a replicated seed so the server sends only the seed and every client renders the identical bolt, including branches.
output:
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local function generateBolt(startPos, endPos, rng, iterations, offsetScale)
    local points = {startPos, endPos}
    local scale = offsetScale
    for _ = 1, iterations do
        local nextPoints = {}
        for i = 1, #points - 1 do
            local a, b = points[i], points[i + 1]
            local mid = (a + b) / 2
            local randomDir = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-1, 1), rng:NextNumber(-1, 1), rng:NextNumber(-1, 1))
            local perp = (b - a):Cross(randomDir)
            if perp.Magnitude > 1e-3 then
                mid += perp.Unit * rng:NextNumber(-1, 1) * scale
            end
            nextPoints[#nextPoints + 1] = a
            nextPoints[#nextPoints + 1] = mid
        end
        nextPoints[#nextPoints + 1] = points[#points]
        points = nextPoints
        scale *= 0.5
    end
    return points
end

local function renderPoints(points, folder, thickness, color)
    for i = 1, #points - 1 do
        local a, b = points[i], points[i + 1]
        local len = (b - a).Magnitude
        if len > 0.01 then
            local seg = Instance.new('Part')
            seg.Anchored = true
            seg.CanCollide = false
            seg.CanQuery = false
            seg.CanTouch = false
            seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            seg.Color = color
            seg.Size = Vector3.new(thickness, thickness, len)
            seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(a, b) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -len / 2)
            seg.Parent = folder
        end
    end
end

-- Same seed + same inputs => same bolt on every client
local function playLightning(startPos, endPos, seed)
    local rng = Random.new(seed)
    local folder = Instance.new('Folder')
    folder.Name = 'Lightning'
    folder.Parent = workspace

    local mainPoints = generateBolt(startPos, endPos, rng, 5, (endPos - startPos).Magnitude * 0.12)
    renderPoints(mainPoints, folder, 0.35, Color3.fromRGB(170, 210, 255))

    for i = 3, #mainPoints - 2 do
        if rng:NextNumber() < 0.12 then
            local branchEnd = mainPoints[i] + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-1, 1), rng:NextNumber(-0.6, 0.2), rng:NextNumber(-1, 1)).Unit * rng:NextNumber(6, 16)
            local branch = generateBolt(mainPoints[i], branchEnd, rng, 3, 2)
            renderPoints(branch, folder, 0.18, Color3.fromRGB(120, 170, 255))
        end
    end
    Debris:AddItem(folder, 0.2)
end

return playLightning

            local s = state[player]
            if not s then
                state[player] = {last = root.Position, safe = root.CFrame, bad = 0, grace = 0}
                continue
            end

            if s.grace > 0 then
                s.grace -= dt
                s.last = root.Position
                s.safe = root.CFrame
                continue
            end

            local dx = root.Position.X - s.last.X
            local dz = root.Position.Z - s.last.Z
            local moved = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
            local allowed = (humanoid.WalkSpeed * SPEED_MULTIPLIER + EXTRA_ALLOWANCE) * dt

            if moved > allowed + 1 then
                s.bad += 1
                if s.bad >= VIOLATION_LIMIT then
                    root.CFrame = s.safe
                    s.bad = 0
                    s.grace = 0.3
                    warn(('[MovementGuard] rolled back %s'):format(player.Name))
                end
            else
                s.bad = math.max(0, s.bad - 0.25)
                s.safe = root.CFrame
            end
            s.last = root.Position
        end
    end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    state[player] = nil
end)

return MovementGuard

instruction: Write a DataStore module in Luau with session locking (UpdateAsync), exponential-backoff retries, template reconciliation, autosave and a safe BindToClose that releases every lock.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService('DataStoreService')
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore('PlayerProfiles_v1')
local TEMPLATE = {Coins = 0, Level = 1, Inventory = {}}
local LOCK_TIMEOUT = 600
local AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL = 90
local JOB_ID = game.JobId ~= '' and game.JobId or ('studio-' .. tostring(os.time()))

local profiles = {}

local function deepCopy(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'table' then return value end
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in value do
        copy[k] = deepCopy(v)
    end
    return copy
end

local function reconcile(data, template)
    for key, value in template do
        if data[key] == nil then
            data[key] = deepCopy(value)
        elseif type(value) == 'table' and type(data[key]) == 'table' then
            reconcile(data[key], value)
        end
    end
end

local function withRetry(fn, attempts)
    local delay = 1
    for attempt = 1, attempts do
        local ok, result = pcall(fn)
        if ok then
            return true, result
        end
        warn(('[Data] attempt %d failed: %s'):format(attempt, tostring(result)))
        if attempt < attempts then
            task.wait(delay + math.random() * 0.5)
            delay *= 2
        end
    end
    return false, nil
end

local function saveProfile(player, release)
    local profile = profiles[player]
    if not profile then return end
    local ok = withRetry(function()
        return store:UpdateAsync(profile.Key, function(old)
            if not old or not old.Lock or old.Lock.JobId ~= JOB_ID then
                return nil  -- we lost the lock; never overwrite another server's data
            end
            old.Data = profile.Data
            if release then
                old.Lock = nil
            else
                old.Lock.Time = os.time()
            end
            return old
        end)
    end, 5)
    if release then
        profiles[player] = nil
    end
    return ok
end

local function loadProfile(player)
    local key = 'Player_' .. player.UserId
    local ok, record = withRetry(function()
        return store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
            old = old or {Data = deepCopy(TEMPLATE)}
            local lock = old.Lock
            if lock and lock.JobId ~= JOB_ID and os.time() - lock.Time < LOCK_TIMEOUT then
                return nil  -- locked by another live server
            end
            old.Lock = {JobId = JOB_ID, Time = os.time()}
            return old
        end)
    end, 5)

    if not ok or type(record) ~= 'table' or not record.Lock or record.Lock.JobId ~= JOB_ID then
        player:Kick('Could not load your data safely. Please rejoin in a moment.')
        return
    end

    reconcile(record.Data, TEMPLATE)
    profiles[player] = {Data = record.Data, Key = key}
    if not player.Parent then
        saveProfile(player, true)  -- left while loading
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(loadProfile)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
    task.spawn(loadProfile, player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    saveProfile(player, true)
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL)
        for player in profiles do
            task.spawn(saveProfile, player, false)
        end
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    if RunService:IsStudio() then task.wait(1) end
    local pending = 0
    for player in profiles do
        pending += 1
        task.spawn(function()
            saveProfile(player, true)
            pending -= 1
        end)
    end
    while pending > 0 do
        task.wait()
    end
end)

return {
    Get = function(player)
        local profile = profiles[player]
        return profile and profile.Data
    end,
}

instruction: Write async helpers in Luau: a safe task spawner that logs full tracebacks, and a retry wrapper with exponential backoff and jitter.
output:
local function safeSpawn(fn, ...)
    return task.spawn(function(...)
        local ok, err = xpcall(fn, debug.traceback, ...)
        if not ok then
            warn('[safeSpawn] ' .. tostring(err))
        end
    end, ...)
end

local function retry(fn, options)
    options = options or {}
    local attempts = options.Attempts or 5
    local baseDelay = options.BaseDelay or 0.5
    local maxDelay = options.MaxDelay or 8

    local lastError
    for attempt = 1, attempts do
        local ok, result = pcall(fn, attempt)
        if ok then
            return true, result
        end
        lastError = result
        if attempt < attempts then
            local delay = math.min(baseDelay * 2 ^ (attempt - 1), maxDelay)
            task.wait(delay * (0.75 + math.random() * 0.5))  -- jitter avoids thundering herd
        end
    end
    return false, lastError
end

return {SafeSpawn = safeSpawn, Retry = retry}

local resultsEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('RaycastResults')  -- BindableEvent

local actors = {}
for _, child in workspace.Workers:GetChildren() do
    if child:IsA('Actor') then
        table.insert(actors, child)
    end
end

local nextJobId = 0
local function dispatch(origins, directions)
    nextJobId += 1
    local n = #origins
    local chunk = math.ceil(n / #actors)
    for i, actor in actors do
        local from = (i - 1) * chunk + 1
        local to = math.min(i * chunk, n)
        if from <= to then
            actor:SendMessage(
                'RaycastBatch',
                table.move(origins, from, to, 1, {}),
                table.move(directions, from, to, 1, {}),
                nextJobId,
                from
            )
        end
    end
    return nextJobId
end

resultsEvent.Event:Connect(function(jobId, offset, hits)
    -- merge hits[i] into global result slot (offset + i - 1)
end)

local actor = script:GetActor()
local resultsEvent = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild('RaycastResults')

actor:BindToMessageParallel('RaycastBatch', function(origins, directions, jobId, offset)
    local hits = table.create(#origins, false)
    for i = 1, #origins do
        local result = workspace:Raycast(origins[i], directions[i])  -- read-only queries are allowed in parallel
        if result then
            hits[i] = result.Position
        end
    end

    resultsEvent:Fire(jobId, offset, hits)
end)

instruction: Implement a spatial hash grid in Luau for fast radius queries of thousands of moving entities such as projectiles and VFX.
output:
local SpatialHash = {}
SpatialHash.__index = SpatialHash

function SpatialHash.new(cellSize)
    return setmetatable({
        _cell = cellSize,
        _cells = {},   -- [hash] = { [id] = true }
        _items = {},   -- [id] = {pos = Vector3, data = any, hash = number}
    }, SpatialHash)
end

local function hashCell(cx, cy, cz)
    return bit32.bxor(cx * 73856093, cy * 19349663, cz * 83492791)
end

function SpatialHash:_hashFor(pos)
    local c = self._cell
    return hashCell(math.floor(pos.X / c), math.floor(pos.Y / c), math.floor(pos.Z / c))
end

function SpatialHash:Insert(id, pos, data)
    local hash = self:_hashFor(pos)
    self._items[id] = {pos = pos, data = data, hash = hash}
    local cell = self._cells[hash]
    if not cell then
        cell = {}
        self._cells[hash] = cell
    end
    cell[id] = true
end

function SpatialHash:Remove(id)
    local item = self._items[id]
    if not item then return end
    local cell = self._cells[item.hash]
    if cell then
        cell[id] = nil
        if next(cell) == nil then
            self._cells[item.hash] = nil
        end
    end
    self._items[id] = nil
end

function SpatialHash:Move(id, newPos)
    local item = self._items[id]
    if not item then return end
    local newHash = self:_hashFor(newPos)
    if newHash ~= item.hash then
        local oldCell = self._cells[item.hash]
        if oldCell then
            oldCell[id] = nil
            if next(oldCell) == nil then
                self._cells[item.hash] = nil
            end
        end
        local cell = self._cells[newHash]
        if not cell then
            cell = {}
            self._cells[newHash] = cell
        end
        cell[id] = true
        item.hash = newHash
    end
    item.pos = newPos
end

function SpatialHash:Query(center, radius)
    local c = self._cell
    local minX, maxX = math.floor((center.X - radius) / c), math.floor((center.X + radius) / c)
    local minY, maxY = math.floor((center.Y - radius) / c), math.floor((center.Y + radius) / c)
    local minZ, maxZ = math.floor((center.Z - radius) / c), math.floor((center.Z + radius) / c)
    local radiusSq = radius * radius
    local seen, results = {}, {}
    for x = minX, maxX do
        for y = minY, maxY do
            for z = minZ, maxZ do
                local cell = self._cells[hashCell(x, y, z)]
                if cell then
                    for id in cell do
                        if not seen[id] then
                            seen[id] = true
                            local item = self._items[id]
                            local d = item.pos - center
                            if d:Dot(d) <= radiusSq then  -- exact check also filters hash collisions
                                results[#results + 1] = id
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return results
end

return SpatialHash

instruction: Write a fixed-timestep projectile simulation with render interpolation in Luau using PreSimulation and PreRender.

local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local STEP = 1 / 60
local MAX_STEPS = 5
local GRAVITY = Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity, 0)
local DRAG = 0.15

local projectiles = {}  -- { part, pos, prevPos, vel }
local accumulator = 0

local function spawnProjectile(part, position, velocity)
    table.insert(projectiles, {part = part, pos = position, prevPos = position, vel = velocity})
end

local function simulate(p, dt)
    p.prevPos = p.pos
    p.vel += GRAVITY * dt
    p.vel -= p.vel * DRAG * dt
    p.pos += p.vel * dt
end

RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
    accumulator += math.min(dt, 0.25)  -- clamp to avoid the spiral of death
    local steps = 0
    while accumulator >= STEP and steps < MAX_STEPS do
        for _, p in projectiles do
            simulate(p, STEP)
        end
        accumulator -= STEP
        steps += 1
    end
    if steps == MAX_STEPS then
        accumulator = 0
    end
end)

RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
    local alpha = accumulator / STEP
    for i = #projectiles, 1, -1 do
        local p = projectiles[i]
        if not p.part.Parent then
            table.remove(projectiles, i)
        else
            p.part.Position = p.prevPos:Lerp(p.pos, alpha)  -- smooth visuals independent of frame rate
        end
    end
end)

return spawnProjectile

instruction: Create a frame-budgeted VFX scheduler in Luau that spreads expensive effect spawns across frames using priorities and drops stale low-priority jobs.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local FRAME_BUDGET = 0.002   -- seconds per frame spent on queued jobs
local MAX_AGE = 0.5          -- stale jobs below this priority get dropped
local DROP_PRIORITY = 3

local queue = {}
local dirty = false

local Scheduler = {}

function Scheduler.Schedule(fn, priority)
    table.insert(queue, {fn = fn, priority = priority or 1, t = os.clock()})
    dirty = true
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if #queue == 0 then return end
    if dirty then
        table.sort(queue, function(a, b)
            if a.priority ~= b.priority then
                return a.priority > b.priority
            end
            return a.t < b.t
        end)
        dirty = false
    end

    local start = os.clock()
    local now = start
    while #queue > 0 and os.clock() - start < FRAME_BUDGET do
        local job = table.remove(queue, 1)
        if job.priority >= DROP_PRIORITY or now - job.t <= MAX_AGE then
            local ok, err = pcall(job.fn)
            if not ok then
                warn('[VFXScheduler] ' .. tostring(err))
            end
        end
    end
end)

return Scheduler

local Stats = {}
local WARN_MS = 2

local function profiled(label, fn)
    return function(...)
        debug.profilebegin(label)
        local start = os.clock()
        local packed = table.pack(pcall(fn, ...))
        local elapsed = (os.clock() - start) * 1000
        debug.profileend()  -- always balanced, even on error

        local s = Stats[label]
        if not s then
            s = {calls = 0, total = 0, max = 0}
            Stats[label] = s
        end
        s.calls += 1
        s.total += elapsed
        s.max = math.max(s.max, elapsed)
        if elapsed > WARN_MS then
            warn(string.format('[Perf] %s took %.2f ms', label, elapsed))
        end

        if not packed[1] then
            error(packed[2], 0)
        end
        return table.unpack(packed, 2, packed.n)
    end
end

local function report()
    for label, s in Stats do
        print(string.format('%-24s avg %.3f ms | max %.3f ms | calls %d', label, s.total / s.calls, s.max, s.calls))
    end
end

return {Profiled = profiled, Report = report}

export type ImpactConfig = {
    Color: Color3,
    Count: number,
    Lifetime: number,
    Radius: number,

local function clampNumber(value: any, min: number, max: number, fallback: number): number
    if typeof(value) ~= 'number' or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then

    end
    return math.clamp(value, min, max)

        Lifetime = clampNumber(source.Lifetime, 0.1, 5, 1),

instruction: Create a data-driven VFX sequencer in Luau: effects are described as timelines of events, played by a single Heartbeat loop with cancel support and error isolation per event.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local Sequencer = {}
local handlers = {}

function Sequencer.RegisterHandler(name, fn)
    handlers[name] = fn
end

function Sequencer.Play(definition, context)
    local events = table.clone(definition.events)
    table.sort(events, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end)

    local index = 1
    local startTime = os.clock()
    local connection
    local handle = {}

    function handle.Cancel()
        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
            connection = nil
        end
    end

    connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local elapsed = os.clock() - startTime
        while index <= #events and events[index].t <= elapsed do
            local event = events[index]
            index += 1
            local handler = handlers[event.action]
            if handler then
                task.spawn(handler, context, event.args or {})  -- one bad handler can't kill the timeline
            else
                warn('[Sequencer] missing handler: ' .. tostring(event.action))
            end
        end
        if index > #events and elapsed >= definition.duration then
            handle.Cancel()
            if definition.OnFinished then
                task.spawn(definition.OnFinished, context)
            end
        end
    end)
    return handle
end

-- Example ------------------------------------------------------------
Sequencer.RegisterHandler('Flash', function(ctx, args) end)
Sequencer.RegisterHandler('Shockwave', function(ctx, args) end)
Sequencer.RegisterHandler('CameraShake', function(ctx, args) end)
Sequencer.RegisterHandler('Debris', function(ctx, args) end)

local GroundSlam = {
    duration = 1.4,
    events = {
        {t = 0.00, action = 'Flash', args = {Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Duration = 0.15}},
        {t = 0.05, action = 'Shockwave', args = {Radius = 30}},
        {t = 0.05, action = 'CameraShake', args = {Intensity = 6, Duration = 0.5}},
        {t = 0.10, action = 'Debris', args = {Count = 14}},
        {t = 0.45, action = 'Shockwave', args = {Radius = 50}},
    },
}

local handle = Sequencer.Play(GroundSlam, {Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)})
return Sequencer

local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')
local Players = game:GetService('Players')

local TimeDilation = {}
local current = 1

local function applyScale(scale)
    current = scale
    for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged('VFXEmitter') do
        if instance:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then
            instance.TimeScale = scale
        end
    end
    local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
    if animator then
        for _, track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
            track:AdjustSpeed(scale)  -- assumes base speed 1; store per-track base speed if you use others
        end
    end
end

function TimeDilation.Slow(scale, holdTime, recoverTime)
    local value = Instance.new('NumberValue')
    value.Value = current
    value.Changed:Connect(applyScale)

    TweenService:Create(value, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Value = scale}):Play()
    task.delay(holdTime, function()
        local recover = TweenService:Create(value, TweenInfo.new(recoverTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Value = 1})
        recover:Play()
        recover.Completed:Once(function()
            applyScale(1)
            value:Destroy()
        end)
    end)
end

function TimeDilation.Get()
    return current
end

return TimeDilation

instruction: Create a lock-on combat camera in Luau using springs for smooth following, framing both the player and the target, with wall collision.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local Spring = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Spring)

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local BIND_NAME = 'LockOnCamera'

local function lockOn(character, targetModel)
    local root = character:WaitForChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local targetRoot = targetModel.PrimaryPart or targetModel:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not targetRoot then return end

    local previousType = camera.CameraType
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

    local focusSpring = Spring.new(targetRoot.Position, 6, 1)
    local positionSpring = Spring.new(camera.CFrame.Position, 5, 1)

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, targetModel}

    local function unlock()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND_NAME)
        camera.CameraType = previousType
    end

    RunService:BindToRenderStep(BIND_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
        if not root.Parent or not targetRoot.Parent then
            unlock()
            return
        end
        local playerPos = root.Position
        local targetPos = targetRoot.Position

        focusSpring.Target = playerPos:Lerp(targetPos, 0.4) + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

        local away = (playerPos - targetPos) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
        local direction = if away.Magnitude > 0.1 then away.Unit else -root.CFrame.LookVector
        local anchor = playerPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        local desired = playerPos + direction * 14 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)

        local hit = workspace:Raycast(anchor, desired - anchor, params)
        if hit then
            desired = hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.5  -- pull the camera in front of walls
        end
        positionSpring.Target = desired

        camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(positionSpring:Update(dt), focusSpring:Update(dt))
    end)
    return unlock
end

return lockOn

local UserInputService = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local Spring = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Spring)

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local swaySpring = Spring.new(Vector3.zero, 8, 0.6)   -- x = yaw, y = pitch, z = roll
local bobSpring = Spring.new(Vector3.zero, 10, 0.8)
local OFFSET = CFrame.new(0.6, -0.5, -1.2)

local function bindViewmodel(viewmodel)
    RunService:BindToRenderStep('Viewmodel', Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function(dt)
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root then return end

        -- mouse delta only reports while the mouse is locked (first person)
        local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
        swaySpring:Impulse(Vector3.new(-delta.X, -delta.Y, -delta.X) * 0.02)
        swaySpring.Target = Vector3.zero
        local sway = swaySpring:Update(dt)

        local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
        local moving = math.clamp(speed / 16, 0, 1)
        local t = os.clock()
        bobSpring.Target = Vector3.new(
            math.sin(t * 9) * 0.02 * moving,
            math.abs(math.cos(t * 9)) * 0.02 * moving,
            0
        )
        local bob = bobSpring:Update(dt)

        viewmodel:PivotTo(camera.CFrame * OFFSET * CFrame.new(bob) * CFrame.Angles(sway.Y, sway.X, sway.Z))
    end)
end

return bindViewmodel

local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local function createRope(startPos, segmentCount, segmentLength)
    local folder = Instance.new('Folder')
    folder.Name = 'Rope'
    folder.Parent = workspace

    local points = {}
    for i = 1, segmentCount + 1 do
        local pos = startPos - Vector3.new(0, (i - 1) * segmentLength, 0)
        local part = Instance.new('Part')
        part.Size = Vector3.one * 0.2
        part.Transparency = 1
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.CanQuery = false
        part.CanTouch = false
        part.Position = pos
        part.Parent = folder
        local attachment = Instance.new('Attachment')
        attachment.Parent = part
        points[i] = {pos = pos, prev = pos, pinned = (i == 1), part = part, attachment = attachment}
    end

    for i = 1, #points - 1 do
        local beam = Instance.new('Beam')
        beam.Attachment0 = points[i].attachment
        beam.Attachment1 = points[i + 1].attachment
        beam.Width0 = 0.15
        beam.Width1 = 0.15
        beam.FaceCamera = true
        beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 30))
        beam.Parent = folder
    end

    local gravity = Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity, 0)
    local rope = {Anchor = points[1], Folder = folder}

    local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        dt = math.min(dt, 1 / 30)
        for _, p in points do
            if not p.pinned then
                local velocity = (p.pos - p.prev) * 0.99
                p.prev = p.pos
                p.pos += velocity + gravity * dt * dt
            end
        end
        for _ = 1, 8 do
            for i = 1, #points - 1 do
                local a, b = points[i], points[i + 1]
                local delta = b.pos - a.pos
                local dist = delta.Magnitude
                if dist > 1e-4 then
                    local correction = delta * ((dist - segmentLength) / dist)
                    if a.pinned then
                        b.pos -= correction
                    elseif b.pinned then
                        a.pos += correction
                    else
                        a.pos += correction * 0.5
                        b.pos -= correction * 0.5
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, p in points do
            p.part.Position = p.pos
        end
    end)

    function rope.Destroy()
        connection:Disconnect()
        folder:Destroy()
    end
    return rope
end

return createRope

instruction: Write a cubic Bezier homing projectile in Luau that curves toward a moving target and orients along its tangent.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local function bezier3(p0, p1, p2, p3, t)
    local u = 1 - t
    return u * u * u * p0 + 3 * u * u * t * p1 + 3 * u * t * t * p2 + t * t * t * p3
end

local function launchHoming(origin, targetPart, duration, onHit)
    local orb = Instance.new('Part')
    orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    orb.Size = Vector3.one * 1.5
    orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    orb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 200)
    orb.Anchored = true
    orb.CanCollide = false
    orb.CanQuery = false
    orb.CanTouch = false
    orb.Position = origin
    orb.Parent = workspace

    local side = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0, math.random() - 0.5).Unit * 25
    local up = Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)
    local startTime = os.clock()

    local connection
    connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not targetPart.Parent then
            connection:Disconnect()
            orb:Destroy()
            return
        end
        local t = math.min((os.clock() - startTime) / duration, 1)
        local p3 = targetPart.Position  -- re-aimed every frame, so the path adapts
        local p1 = origin + up + side
        local p2 = p3 + up + side * 0.3

        local pos = bezier3(origin, p1, p2, p3, t)
        local ahead = bezier3(origin, p1, p2, p3, math.min(t + 0.02, 1))
        if (ahead - pos).Magnitude > 1e-3 then
            orb.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, ahead)
        else
            orb.Position = pos
        end

        if t >= 1 then
            connection:Disconnect()
            orb:Destroy()
            if onHit then onHit(p3) end
        end
    end)
end

return launchHoming

instruction: Solve target leading in Luau: compute the intercept point for a projectile of constant speed against a moving target using the quadratic solution.
output:
local function interceptPoint(shooterPos, targetPos, targetVel, projectileSpeed)
    local toTarget = targetPos - shooterPos
    local a = targetVel:Dot(targetVel) - projectileSpeed * projectileSpeed
    local b = 2 * targetVel:Dot(toTarget)
    local c = toTarget:Dot(toTarget)

    local t
    if math.abs(a) < 1e-6 then
        -- projectile and target speed are equal: linear equation
        if math.abs(b) < 1e-6 then return nil end
        t = -c / b
    else
        local discriminant = b * b - 4 * a * c
        if discriminant < 0 then return nil end  -- cannot catch the target
        local root = math.sqrt(discriminant)
        local t1 = (-b + root) / (2 * a)
        local t2 = (-b - root) / (2 * a)
        t = math.huge
        if t1 > 0 then t = math.min(t, t1) end
        if t2 > 0 then t = math.min(t, t2) end
        if t == math.huge then return nil end
    end

    if t <= 0 then return nil end
    return targetPos + targetVel * t, t
end

-- local point, flightTime = interceptPoint(origin, targetRoot.Position, targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity, 90)
-- if point then direction = (point - origin).Unit end
return interceptPoint

instruction: Write a Catmull-Rom spline sampler in Luau and use it to fly the camera through waypoints for a cinematic with eased FOV.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')

local function catmullRom(p0, p1, p2, p3, t)
    local t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
    return 0.5 * (
        (2 * p1)
        + (-p0 + p2) * t
        + (2 * p0 - 5 * p1 + 4 * p2 - p3) * t2
        + (-p0 + 3 * p1 - 3 * p2 + p3) * t3
    )
end

local function samplePath(points, alpha)
    local segments = #points - 1
    local scaled = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1) * segments
    local i = math.min(math.floor(scaled) + 1, segments)
    local t = scaled - (i - 1)
    local p0 = points[math.max(i - 1, 1)]
    local p1 = points[i]
    local p2 = points[i + 1]
    local p3 = points[math.min(i + 2, #points)]
    return catmullRom(p0, p1, p2, p3, t)
end

local function playCinematic(points, lookTarget, duration, fovFrom, fovTo, onDone)
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local previousType = camera.CameraType
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    local startTime = os.clock()

    RunService:BindToRenderStep('Cinematic', Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
        local a = (os.clock() - startTime) / duration
        if a >= 1 then
            RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep('Cinematic')
            camera.CameraType = previousType
            if onDone then onDone() end
            return
        end
        local eased = TweenService:GetValue(a, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(samplePath(points, eased), lookTarget)
        camera.FieldOfView = fovFrom + (fovTo - fovFrom) * eased
    end)
end

return {Sample = samplePath, Play = playCinematic}

instruction: Write a hitbox module in Luau using GetPartBoundsInBox that deduplicates hits per swing, supports debug visualization and is driven by animation markers.
output:
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local Hitbox = {}
Hitbox.__index = Hitbox

function Hitbox.new(character, size, offset, onHit)
    local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
    overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    return setmetatable({
        Debug = false,
        _char = character,
        _size = size,
        _offset = offset,
        _onHit = onHit,
        _overlap = overlap,
        _hit = {},
        _connection = nil,
    }, Hitbox)
end

function Hitbox:Cast()
    local root = self._char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not root then return end
    local cf = root.CFrame * self._offset
    for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf, self._size, self._overlap) do
        local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
        if model and not self._hit[model] then
            local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                self._hit[model] = true
                self._onHit(model, humanoid, part)
            end
        end
    end
    if self.Debug then
        local box = Instance.new('Part')
        box.Anchored = true
        box.CanCollide = false
        box.CanQuery = false
        box.CanTouch = false
        box.Transparency = 0.7
        box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        box.Size = self._size
        box.CFrame = cf
        box.Parent = workspace
        Debris:AddItem(box, 0.1)
    end
end

function Hitbox:Start()   -- call from the 'HitStart' animation marker
    table.clear(self._hit)
    if self._connection then return end
    self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        self:Cast()
    end)
end

function Hitbox:Stop()    -- call from the 'HitEnd' animation marker
    if self._connection then
        self._connection:Disconnect()
        self._connection = nil
    end
end

return Hitbox

instruction: Write an R15 ragdoll module in Luau that swaps Motor6Ds for BallSocketConstraints and can restore the character afterwards.
output:
local function ragdoll(character)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    if not humanoid then return end

    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
    local root = character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if root then
        root.CanCollide = false
    end

    local created = {}
    local disabledMotors = {}

    for _, motor in character:GetDescendants() do
        if motor:IsA('Motor6D') and motor.Part0 and motor.Part1
            and motor.Name ~= 'Root' and motor.Name ~= 'RootJoint' then
            local a0 = Instance.new('Attachment')
            a0.CFrame = motor.C0
            a0.Parent = motor.Part0

            local a1 = Instance.new('Attachment')
            a1.CFrame = motor.C1
            a1.Parent = motor.Part1

            local socket = Instance.new('BallSocketConstraint')
            socket.Attachment0 = a0
            socket.Attachment1 = a1
            socket.LimitsEnabled = true
            socket.UpperAngle = 60
            socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
            socket.TwistLowerAngle = -40
            socket.TwistUpperAngle = 40
            socket.Parent = motor.Part0

            motor.Enabled = false
            table.insert(created, a0)
            table.insert(created, a1)
            table.insert(created, socket)
            table.insert(disabledMotors, motor)
        end
    end

    local function restore()
        for _, instance in created do
            instance:Destroy()
        end
        for _, motor in disabledMotors do
            motor.Enabled = true
        end
        if root then
            root.CanCollide = true
        end
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end
    return restore
end

return ragdoll
-- Set humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false at spawn if you ragdoll on death.

local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local function groundCrack(origin, direction, length, segments)
    local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
    flat = flat.Unit
    local side = Vector3.new(-flat.Z, 0, flat.X)

    local folder = Instance.new('Folder')
    folder.Name = 'GroundCrack'
    folder.Parent = workspace

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {folder}

    local lastPos = origin
    for i = 1, segments do
        local alpha = i / segments
        local jag = math.noise(i * 0.7 + 0.3, origin.X * 0.1 + 5.1, 0.3) * 8
        local target = origin + flat * (length * alpha) + side * jag
        local result = workspace:Raycast(target + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), params)
        if result then
            local pos = result.Position + result.Normal * 0.05
            local segLength = (pos - lastPos).Magnitude
            if segLength > 0.1 then
                local crack = Instance.new('Part')
                crack.Anchored = true
                crack.CanCollide = false
                crack.CanQuery = false
                crack.CanTouch = false
                crack.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
                crack.Color = Color3.fromRGB(15, 10, 10)
                crack.Size = Vector3.new(0.9 * (1 - alpha) + 0.25, 0.1, segLength)
                crack.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(lastPos, pos) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -segLength / 2)
                crack.Parent = folder
                TweenService:Create(crack, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
                lastPos = pos
            end
        end
    end
    Debris:AddItem(folder, 2.5)
end

return groundCrack

instruction: Write an off-screen target indicator in Luau that converts a world position to viewport space, clamps it to the screen edge when off-screen or behind the camera, and rotates an arrow toward it.
output:
local function updateMarker(marker, worldPosition)
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
    local center = viewport / 2
    local margin = 40

    local screenPoint, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPosition)
    local pos = Vector2.new(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y)

    if screenPoint.Z > 0 and onScreen then
        marker.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
        marker.Rotation = 0
        return true
    end

    if screenPoint.Z < 0 then
        pos = center - (pos - center)  -- behind the camera: flip across the center
    end

    local offset = pos - center
    if offset.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
        offset = Vector2.new(0, 1)
    end

    local scaleX = math.abs(offset.X) > 1e-3 and (center.X - margin) / math.abs(offset.X) or math.huge
    local scaleY = math.abs(offset.Y) > 1e-3 and (center.Y - margin) / math.abs(offset.Y) or math.huge
    local clamped = center + offset * math.min(scaleX, scaleY)

    marker.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(clamped.X, clamped.Y)
    marker.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(offset.Y, offset.X)) + 90  -- arrow art points up by default
    return false
end

return updateMarker
-- The marker's ScreenGui needs IgnoreGuiInset = true so coordinates match the viewport.
